body: 画一张三列四行的职场表情合集，角色统一为胖橘猫，佩戴深蓝领带，手绘蜡笔风，浅米色背景。十二格依次配短语“早上好”“开工了”“收到”“我想想”“马上来”“辛苦了”“午饭时间”“继续努力”“有点困”“完成了”“下班啦”“明天见”。动作与文字呼应，猫的脸型和颜色保持一致，文字清晰，格子间隔相同。

en.title: Orange office cat sticker sheet
en.description: Twelve orange-cat workplace stickers in three columns and four rows
en.body:
## How to use

Use the exact recorded prompt. No reference image is required. Changes to the prompt or inputs create an untested variant.

## Observed result

Twelve orange-cat workplace stickers in three columns and four rows. All twelve requested Chinese captions are legible and match the prompt; navy ties and crayon style remain consistent.

## Source and generation

The source provides an original prompt; this production uses the separately recorded working prompt. [Source](https://x.com/karanwithai/status/2118156092865994837/photo/1). Source-post engagement does not measure this newly generated example.

Produced with the built-in GPT Image tool. The tool did not return an exact provider model ID; GPT Image 2.6 is the research topic, not a verified version claim for this output. All reference images used here were generated for this project.

使用本次实际提交的提示词，无需参考图。修改提示词或底图后属于未验证的新变体。
